title: The Last Unicorn
author: Peter S. Beagle
summary: A unicorn learns that she may be the last of her kind and leaves her enchanted forest to find the rest. She is joined by a bumbling magician and a sharp-tongued woman on a trip toward the castle of a haunted king and a fearsome creature.
readIf: you want a lyrical, bittersweet fairy tale with sly humour and a lot of heart.
skipIf: you want an action-driven adventure, as it is meandering, wistful and prefers mood to plot.

pairings.reason: A similar adult fairy tale with romance and gentle wit, a bit lighter and more romantic.
Another short, wistful story with a poetic tone that is quietly about loss and wonder.
Another short, classic fantasy that takes its magic seriously and speaks plainly.
